# MicroAgent Tools — Complete Schema & Invocation Specification

## 100% Free & Open Access Model
Every tool execution is 100% free with zero paywalls, zero rate limits, and zero mandatory API keys.
Optional header:
```http
Authorization: Bearer <any_agent_id>
```
Responses return:
```http
X-Access: free-unlimited
X-Cost: $0.00
Content-Type: application/json
```

---

## 1. SheetDiff (`sheet_diff`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Deterministic primary-key spreadsheet reconciler. Matches rows by unique keys (SKU, Email, ID) and computes cell-level before/after changes.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/sheet_diff`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "baseline_csv": "string (raw CSV/TSV)",
  "updated_csv": "string (raw CSV/TSV)",
  "primary_key": "string|string[] (optional, e.g. 'sku' or ['warehouse','sku'])",
  "case_sensitive": false,
  "numeric_tolerance": "number (optional, absolute tolerance for numeric cells)",
  "detect_moves": "boolean (optional, default true; reports reordered rows)",
  "delimiter": "string (optional; one of , tab ; | :)",
  "headers_case_sensitive": "boolean (optional, default false)"
}
```

---

## 2. TextCleaner (`text_cleaner`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Cleans scraped web content, strips UTM click IDs from URLs, straightens quotes, removes zero-width invisible junk.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/text_cleaner`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "text": "string",
  "strip_tracking_urls": true,
  "fix_line_wraps": true,
  "straighten_quotes": true,
  "remove_invisible_chars": true
}
```

---

## 3. PIIRedactor (`pii_redactor`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Identifies and replaces sensitive personal and financial identifiers with `[REDACTED]`.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/pii_redactor`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "text": "string",
  "redact_credit_cards": true,
  "redact_emails": true,
  "redact_phones": true,
  "redact_ssn": true,
  "redact_api_keys": true,
  "replacement_mask": "[REDACTED]",
  "allow_test_data": "boolean (optional; lets 555-01xx / example.com values through)",
  "custom_patterns": "string[] (optional; extra redaction regexes, max 20)",
  "redact_iban": "boolean (optional, default true; mod-97-validated IBANs)",
  "pseudonymize": "boolean (optional; deterministic [TYPE-N] surrogates)",
  "pseudonym_seed": "string (optional; makes surrogates HMAC-stable across files)"
}
```

## 4. TermsScanner (`terms_risk_scanner`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Analyzes legal agreements for forced arbitration, AI training on user data, and auto-renewal traps.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/terms_risk_scanner`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "terms_text": "string"
}
```

## 5. ReceiptParser (`receipt_parser`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Parses billing text or invoice dumps into structured JSON with vendor, date, invoice #, tax, and total.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/receipt_parser`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "document_text": "string"
}
```

---

## 6. InvoiceBuilder (`invoice_builder`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Computes line items, taxes, discounts, and generates formatted invoice breakdowns.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/invoice_builder`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "doc_type": "INVOICE",
  "number": "INV-2026-001",
  "date": "2026-10-26",
  "due_date": "2026-11-09",
  "currency": "$",
  "items": [
    { "description": "Cloud Architecture Optimization", "quantity": 10, "rate": 150 }
  ],
  "tax_percent": 8.25,
  "payment_instructions": "Wire: SVB Acct 12345"
}
```

## 7. OGCardGenerator (`og_card_generator`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Generates vector 1200x630 SVG social preview cards and HTML / Next.js meta tags.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/og_card_generator`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "badge": "string",
  "brand": "string",
  "url": "https://...",
  "theme": "emerald | purple | sunset | ocean | light"
}
```

## 8. WebAuditor (`website_health_auditor`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Checks a live website for HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options security headers, and Open Graph tags.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/website_health_auditor`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com"
}
```

## 9. CodeCardGenerator (`code_card_generator`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Turns raw code snippets into studio-grade syntax-highlighted SVG graphics with macOS frames.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/code_card_generator`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "code": "string",
  "language": "javascript | python | sql",
  "title": "snippet.js",
  "theme": "midnight | hyper | sunset | emerald | slate"
}
```

---

## 10. PDFProcessor (`pdf_processor`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Headless PDF engine: merges multiple PDFs, fills form fields, stamps checkmarks, and inspects page counts.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/pdf_processor`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "mode": "fill | merge | inspect | sample",
  "pdf_base64": "string",
  "pdf_list": ["base64..."],
  "fields": [
    { "page": 1, "type": "text", "text": "...", "x_percent": 0.2, "y_percent": 0.3 }
  ]
}
```

---

## 11. JSONDiff (`json_diff`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Semantic JSON diffing with primary-key array reconciliation and breaking schema change detection.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/json_diff`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "original_json": {},
  "updated_json": {},
  "primary_key": "auto"
}
```

---

## 12. WebhookVerifier (`webhook_verifier`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Verifies and computes HMAC signatures for Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Slack, Svix, and Paddle.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/webhook_verifier`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "provider": "stripe",
  "payload": "string",
  "secret": "string",
  "received_signature": "string"
}
```

---

## 13. EnvMatrix (`env_matrix`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Audits .env configurations across dev, staging, and prod for missing secrets or test keys in prod.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/env_matrix`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "dev_env": "string",
  "staging_env": "string",
  "prod_env": "string"
}
```

---

## 14. DuckLog (`duck_log`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** In-memory SQL engine for server and application logs (Apache, Nginx, Docker, JSON logs). Supports chained INNER/LEFT JOINs, UNION/UNION ALL, HAVING, DATE_TRUNC bucketing, COUNT/AVG/SUM/P50/P95/P99, and per-table schema discovery.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/duck_log`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "raw_logs": "string",
  "sql_query": "SELECT status, count(*) AS count FROM logs GROUP BY status",
  "extra_tables": "object (optional, e.g. { errors: '<ndjson>' } for JOINs)"
}
```

---

## 15. JwtVerifier (`jwt_verifier`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Decodes JWT claims, audits signature integrity, checks expiration timestamps.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/jwt_verifier`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "jwt_token": "string",
  "secret_key": "string"
}
```

---

## 16. SourceMapDemapper (`sourcemap_demapper`)
* **Cost:** Free ($0.00)
* **Description:** Demaps minified production stack traces back to original TypeScript/JavaScript source files and line numbers.
* **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/tools/sourcemap_demapper`
* **Input Schema:**
```json
{
  "stack_trace": "string",
  "source_map": {}
}
```

---

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Configuration

To connect directly into **Claude Desktop** or **Cursor**:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "micro-agent-tools": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["d:/Free-Micro-SaaS-Tools/src/mcp/server.js"]
    }
  }
}
```
Or for remote HTTP agents:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "micro-agent-tools": {
      "url": "https://api.freetools.dev/v1/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
